title: Study Comparing Blood Levels of ReFacto and Advante in Hemophilia A
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to compare the pharmacokinetic parameters of ReFacto and Advate, using the chromogenetic substrate assay to measure plasma Factor VIII activity in plasma.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Severe hemophilia A
* Previously treated patients with at least 150 exposure days to any Factor VIII product

Exclusion Criteria:

* Hypersensitivity to any recombinant Factor VIII product
* History of or current Factor VIII inhibitor
* Bleeding episode or other reason requiring Factor VIII treatment within 3 days of study
